chunks.chapter: Academic Calendar AY 2026-2027 - Undergraduate
chunks.section: How to answer common calendar questions
chunks.sourceLabel: Academic Calendar AY 2026-2027 - Undergraduate
chunks.keywords: undergraduate UG calendar when academic sem graduating march holiday how answer common
chunks.content:
- "When are the 1st sem finals?" The undergraduate non-graduating final examination period is December 9-19, 2026. Graduating students: November 23-28, 2026. Section-level schedules may differ.
- "When are 2nd sem midterms?" March 15-20, 2027 for undergraduate students.
- "Is Nov 30 a holiday?" It is marked as Bonifacio Day/regular holiday in the USTP academic calendar, but consult university advisories and official proclamations for changes.
- "When is my dean's list?" Calendar lists previous-semester announcements on September 21, 2026 and March 22, 2027; it does not guarantee an individual student appears on the list.

Live notices supersede when confirmed. Do not conflate published exam windows with personally scheduled exam appointments.

chunks.chapter: Admissions, Enrollment, USTAT and Student Registration
chunks.section: Pre-enrollment / PRISMS guide as described on USTP's official site
chunks.sourceLabel: Admissions, Enrollment, USTAT and Student Registration
chunks.keywords: admissions preenrollment USTAT PRISMS enrollment prisms email pre temporary portal subjects confirmation ustat
chunks.content:
- After receiving a USTP application email, verify your email through the official verification link.
- Use the student number/username and temporary credentials provided by the university to access PRISMS; change the temporary password.
- Open the Enrollment area in PRISMS.
- Complete missing profile information if the portal prompts you.
- If the portal reports outstanding liabilities, follow the official eClearance route: https://clearance.ustp.edu.ph/.
- Select the offered class section; subjects associated with it will appear. Tick the desired subjects, register them, and proceed to confirmation.
- Review the enrollment details, save/continue, and print the pre-assessment for validation; USTP says a confirmation email may be sent.

chunks.chapter: Admissions, Enrollment, USTAT and Student Registration

chunks.keywords: admissions USTAT ASO every fee tuition eligible act enrollment ustat registration states
chunks.content: The official university admissions page states eligible/qualified undergraduate students benefit from public funding under Republic Act 10931 (Universal Access to Quality Tertiary Education Act). It does not follow that every student is automatically eligible or that every fee for every level/circumstance is waived. Refer individual eligibility and charges to ASO/Registrar/cashier. A fee information page exists at https://www.ustp.edu.ph/tuition-fees/ but exact amounts in a linked external fee sheet were not verified here.

chunks.content: Do not claim admission slots are open simply because a general admissions portal loads. Do not fabricate passing scores, cutoffs, eligibility exceptions, program-specific requirements, document checklists, application deadlines, current fees, or 'USTAT guaranteed admission'. Do not solicit a student's temporary password, OTP or account recovery tokens. The older official USTAT results page mixes past school years and is unsuitable for live 2027 schedules.

chunks.chapter: USTP CDO Overview, Campus Geography and History
chunks.sourceLabel: USTP CDO Overview, Campus Geography and History
chunks.keywords: campus MUST MOSCAT technology history science state overview geography what southern philippines
chunks.content:
The University of Science and Technology of Southern Philippines (USTP) is a Philippine public/state university system. The university website states it was established August 16, 2016, under Republic Act 10919, by amalgamating the former Mindanao University of Science and Technology (MUST) in Cagayan de Oro and Misamis Oriental State College of Agriculture and Technology (MOSCAT) in Claveria.
Official general history: https://www.ustp.edu.ph/.

chunks.chapter: USTP CDO Overview, Campus Geography and History
chunks.sourceLabel: USTP CDO Overview, Campus Geography and History
chunks.keywords: campus CHED GPS cagayan oro profile cdeo site states ched overview geography
chunks.content:
- Known as USTP Cagayan de Oro, USTP CDO, or USTP CdeO.
- Address: Claro M. Recto Avenue, Lapasan, Cagayan de Oro City 9000, Philippines.
- Classified as a major campus of the USTP system, not the same site as USTP Balubal or USTP Alubijid.
- Official campus profile states an approximate land area of 9 hectares.
- University states CDO was CHED-recognized Center of Excellence in Information Technology and Centers of Development in Electrical Engineering and Mathematics. These are historical/recognition descriptions on the university profile; confirm current status with CHED when time-sensitive.
- USTP's site features an official 360-degree virtual tour link on its campus profile, but this knowledge pack contains no verified GPS coordinates for individual indoor rooms.
Source: https://www.ustp.edu.ph/campuses/ and https://www.ustp.edu.ph/cdeo/.

chunks.chapter: USTP CDO Overview, Campus Geography and History
chunks.sourceLabel: USTP CDO Overview, Campus Geography and History
chunks.keywords: campus CHED cagayan oro campuses alubijid claveria major also villanueva balubal
chunks.content:
The USTP campus page identifies Alubijid as the university's main campus. Cagayan de Oro and Claveria are major campuses; the same page also calls Villanueva a major campus. Balubal, while within Cagayan de Oro City, is a distinct USTP campus and not interchangeable with the C.M. Recto campus. Jasaan, Oroquieta and Panaon are also distinct. Programs, offices and calendars may apply differently per campus.
The CHED calendar letter covers Alubijid, Balubal, Cagayan de Oro, Claveria, Jasaan, Oroquieta, Panaon, Villanueva. Its campus coverage does not mean every program or service operates identically on all sites.

chunks.content:
- C1 - Issue: UG midyear 2027 term summary says June 9 start on PDF p. 2; detail says June 5 start on p. 5; Severity: HIGH; Correct agent handling: Give both with source/page; ask for confirmation; no auto-reminder
- C2 - Issue: 2027 May 10 transferee/second-course row still names AY 2026-2027 on PDF p. 5; Severity: HIGH; Correct agent handling: Quote year exactly and flag mismatch, do not silently "fix"
- C3 - Issue: Graduate midyear detailed row says start of classes June 5, but enrollment June 5-11 on p. 6; Severity: MEDIUM; Correct agent handling: Report overlap; do not assume a specific student's start/late enrollment policy
- C4 - Issue: PDF page 2 repeats UNDERGRADUATE (UG) term summary heading twice beside UG/GR calendars; Severity: MEDIUM; Correct agent handling: Don't invent unambiguously named GR term dates from duplicate heading

chunks.chapter: Conflicts, Caveats and Refresh Rules
chunks.sourceLabel: Conflicts, Caveats and Refresh Rules
chunks.keywords: qa CHED ASO conflicts announcement new revision campus academic scope but caveats refresh
chunks.content:
- Authenticated live university announcement / new official calendar revision relevant to campus + academic year and date.
- CHED-noted University Academic Calendar AY 2026-2027 (this package, PDF source reference).
- Current official USTP campus/university website, when it gives the same AY and scope.
- Older USTP public pages clearly dated, labeled historical.
- 2023 student handbook for *policy* questions, but not as source for AY 2026-27 event dates.
- Never use student gossip, unofficial third-party posts or unspecified search snippets as institutional directives.
If a new announcement conflicts with the PDF but you cannot verify scope/revision, explain both and ask the student to check Registrar/ASO.

chunks.content:
- Active admissions, exam changes, scholarships and suspensions: before every time-sensitive answer; old snapshot alone is insufficient.
- Official roles, local extensions, current organizations: monthly while active, or before a direct referral.
- Undergraduate/graduate program lists and library policies: every semester.
- Published academic calendar: at minimum at the start of a term and when the university posts amended dates.
- Campus address and institutional history: annually.

chunks.section: Negative knowledge (not obtained in public research)
chunks.sourceLabel: Conflicts, Caveats and Refresh Rules
chunks.keywords: qa GPS API LAFINA research class portal current conflicts caveats refresh rules negative knowledge
chunks.content:
This research does not verify: actual class/section timetables, course syllabus PDFs, real-time facilities/rooms, campus-wide indoor GPS map, student portal API, student personal grades, class cancellations, current Wi-Fi details or credentials, library live opening hours, individual scholarship eligibility, university-shuttle times, individualized fees, or current graduate admission deadlines beyond the dates in the calendar.
A useful LAFINA response for missing data: "I couldn't verify that from official USTP CDO information. Please check [named official office/portal]."
